name: Captain Bramble
bio: Commands the five towers in Tower Defense from the top of the Archer post. Never sleeps during a wave.

portrait.subject: a cute chubby tower defense commander with a big mustache, a blue pointed helmet with a little crystal on top, holding a spyglass
portrait.background: green grassy hill under a teal sky

request: Commander Bramble of Tower Defense, reporting! Join my defence council? 🗼
hello: Excellent! I'll keep you posted from the watchtower.
First lesson: always build where the path bends. Always.
about: Captain Bramble, at your service! I've held this road for ten waves straight. My towers are my family. The Tesla one is the loud cousin.
how: Place towers beside the enemy path. Archers are cheap, Cannons splash, Mages slow, Tesla chains, Snipers hit far. Survive all 10 waves!
tips: Put towers on the bends of the path: they shoot at enemies coming AND going.
A Mage tower's slow makes every other tower better. Pair them up!
Don't spend all your gold early. Later waves hit much harder.
chat: The Tesla tower zapped a bird. Bird is fine. Tower is smug.
I polished all five towers today. The Cannon wanted a second coat.
Wave 7 is my nemesis. We have history.
Some say defence is boring. Those people have never seen chain lightning.
I drew a map of the path. Then I put tiny towers on it. Then I played with them for an hour.
nudge: Scouts report enemies on the horizon! Man the towers?
My towers are restless. They want to shoot something. Join me!
idle: Commander, the road has been quiet for {ago}. Suspiciously quiet.
{ago} without a wave! My Archers are knitting out of boredom.

questions.q: Strategy question! Which tower is the best?
a: Cheap and reliable! A true classic.
Patient and precise. Just like you.
Slow 'em down and let the others feast. Clever!

update: Defence briefing! Tower Defense was updated to v{version}. Inspect the new defences!
